description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincial government-operated retail outlet selling wine, spirits, beer, coolers, and ciders, part of the 198-store BCLIQUOR chain run by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch. Located on 100 Street in Fort St. John, it serves as the primary source for packaged alcohol in this northern BC hub city. Touring cyclists passing through Fort St. John can stock up on beverages here as a convenient stop along the Alaska Highway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's store locator page title explicitly confirms 'FORT ST. JOHN - Store Hours & Location', validating this is a real, operating BCLIQUOR retail location. The about page confirms BCLIQUOR operates 198 stores across BC as a government-run retailer. No specific amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) is present on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields default to null.
concerns: Store locator page rendered mostly generic/template content; specific store address and phone could not be independently verified from website text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible government-operated retail store confirmed by website. A useful resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Fort St. John.
